Ice Cream In A Bag
By: Anonymous
Published: Saturday, January 2, 2010 - 12:52am

Ingredients




1/2 cup Half and Half
1/4 teaspoon Vanilla flavoring
4 teaspoons Sugar

Preparation

1 This is a fun activity for a kid's party - everyone makes their own ice cream. 2 Put the milk, vanilla and sugar in a zip-lock baggie and close tightly. 3 Place this in a larger zip-lock baggie along with 6-8 ice cubes and 2 T. salt. 4 Close this bag tightly also. 5 Shake the bags. 6 The cream will soon freeze into ice cream. 7 Either eat immediately or take the small bag out and rinse off and freeze to "ripen." 8 You can add some chocolate sauce if you want chocolate ice cream.
